info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Partnerships Retrieval API
info.description: The Corporate Partnerships Retrieval API allows consumers to access detailed information about existing corporate partnerships. This endpoint serves financial institutions and corporate clients who need to review partnership details for strategic decision-making. By utilizing this API, users can retrieve specific partnership data based on unique identifiers. Typical use cases include assessing partnership performance, compliance checks, and market analysis.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific corporate partnership using its unique identifier. This endpoint provides all the relevant information about the partnership, including the partners involved, terms, and status.

requestBody.description: Retrieve information regarding a specific corporate partnership identified by the unique resource identifier. The request body must adhere to the specified schema, providing all required fields in JSON format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested partnership details.

GetCorporatePartnershipByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Operations GET request related to corporate partnerships.

stakeholderId.description: The unique identifier for the stakeholder involved in the engagement.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement.

subject.description: The subject or title of the engagement.

scheduledAt.description: The scheduled date and time for the engagement in ISO 8601 format.

relationshipOwnerId.description: The identifier for the owner of the relationship.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the engagement record.

version.description: The version of the engagement record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the engagement was last updated in ISO 8601 format.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the engagement, providing additional context and tracking information.

GetCorporatePartnershipByIdResponse_200.description: A response object representing the details of a corporate partnership engagement.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracing related requests.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp marking when the metadata was generated in ISO 8601 format.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing took place.

EngagementMetadata.description: Metadata for tracking and contextual information related to an engagement.
